# live2d-web

Unofficial Live2D Cubism runtime for vanilla JavaScript and React. The default
backend uses WebGL2 without Pixi. Cubism Core and model files are never bundled.

## Documentation

- English: /docs/en
- 한국어: /docs/ko
- 日本語: /docs/ja
- API reference: /docs/en/api
- Model inspector: /inspect
